bpmn.label: Collaboration
bpmn.about: Two or more pools exchanging message flows.

bpmn.label: Single pool
bpmn.about: One pool divided into lanes, with no message flows.

comparison.label: T-chart
comparison.about: Two or more labelled columns of points.

comparison.label: Pros and cons
comparison.about: A question, with its pros in one column and its cons in the other.

comparison.label: Matrix
comparison.about: Options across, criteria down; each cell is text or yes / partial / no.

comparison.label: Decision
comparison.about: Weighted scores; the engine computes totals, ranks and the winner.

comparison.label: Double bubble
comparison.about: Two subjects, what they share between them, what is unique outside.

decisiontree.label: Question tree
decisiontree.about: Yes/no questions that lead to a classification or a next step, with no probabilities or payoffs. The default when the header has no suffix.

decisiontree.label: Decision analysis
decisiontree.about: Decision and chance nodes with probabilities and payoffs, rolled back to expected values. Header `decisiontree:decision`.

decisiontree.label: Classifier tree
decisiontree.about: A trained model's splits and leaf classes with sample counts. Header `decisiontree:ml`.

decisiontree.label: Influence diagram
decisiontree.about: Decision, chance and value nodes joined by influence arcs, drawn as a network rather than a tree. Header `decisiontree:influence`.

evacuation.label: ISO 23601
evacuation.about: ISO 7010 safe-condition and fire-equipment symbols with the ISO legend. The default.

evacuation.label: NFPA 170
evacuation.about: US fire-safety symbols and NFPA legend conventions.

evacuation.label: UAE Civil Defence
evacuation.about: UAE Civil Defence plan symbols and its required legend.

gitgraph.label: Horizontal
gitgraph.about: Time runs left to right with one lane per branch, as in the Pro Git book, Atlassian tutorials and Mermaid. The default.

gitgraph.label: Vertical
gitgraph.about: Newest commit at the top, one row per commit with its message beside it, as in git log --graph and desktop Git clients (`gitgraph BT`).

logic.label: ANSI / IEEE 91 shapes
logic.about: Distinctive gate outlines: D-shaped AND, curved OR, triangle buffers. The default.

logic.label: IEC 60617 rectangles
logic.about: Every gate a rectangle with its function symbol (&, ≥1, =1) inside.

matrix.label: Quadrant
matrix.about: Items placed on two axes into named quadrants: BCG, Eisenhower, impact–effort, stakeholder maps.

matrix.label: Heatmap
matrix.about: A scored grid coloured by value, such as a 5×5 risk matrix.

matrix.label: Correlation matrix
matrix.about: A symmetric grid of pairwise relationships among one set of items.

matrix.label: SIPOC
matrix.about: Suppliers, inputs, process, outputs and customers in five columns.

matrix.label: House of quality
matrix.about: Customer requirements against technical characteristics in a QFD relationship grid.

matrix.label: Punnett square
matrix.about: Parental alleles along two edges and offspring genotypes in the cells.

mindmap.label: Radial map
mindmap.about: The root in the centre with branches fanning out on both sides. The default.

mindmap.label: Logic chart
mindmap.about: The root on the left and a tidy tree growing to the right; `%% style: driver` draws a driver diagram the same way.

mindmap.label: Futures wheel
mindmap.about: Consequences in concentric rings around a central change, one ring per order of effect.

orgchart.label: Tree
orgchart.about: Boxes in a reporting hierarchy joined by connector lines. The default.

orgchart.label: Directory list
orgchart.about: The same hierarchy as a compact indented list (`layout: list`).

pert.label: Network
pert.about: Activity-on-node boxes ranked by longest path.

pert.label: Activity on arrow
pert.about: Activities drawn as arrows between numbered event circles, with dashed dummy arcs where dependencies need them (`layout: aoa`).

pert.label: Time-scaled
pert.about: Boxes placed on a time axis at their early start.

pert.label: Gantt
pert.about: Calendar bars placed from the computed schedule.

playbook.label: Football
playbook.about: American football on a yard-lined field.

playbook.label: Basketball
playbook.about: Half court with rim, elbow, wing and corner landmarks.

playbook.label: Soccer
playbook.about: Pitch with penalty areas, runs and passes.

prisma.label: Dual pipeline
prisma.about: A second column for records found by other methods.

sld.label: ANSI / IEEE 315 symbols
sld.about: North American one-line symbols for breakers, transformers and switches.

sld.label: IEC 60617 symbols
sld.about: IEC one-line symbols, also used by the ABNT NBR 5410 and AS/NZS 3000 profiles.

timeline.label: Swimlane
timeline.about: Events on one time axis, grouped into horizontal tracks. The default.

timeline.label: Gantt bars
timeline.about: Each item a bar from its start to its end date on its own row; dates are typed, not computed (for a computed schedule see pert).

timeline.label: Lollipop
timeline.about: Point events on stems above and below a single axis line.

venn.label: Venn
venn.about: Every combination of sets drawn as an overlap region, whether or not it holds anything.

venn.label: Euler
venn.about: Only the relations that exist: subsets nest inside their superset and disjoint sets stand apart.

welding.label: AWS A2.4 / ISO 2553 system B
welding.about: A single solid reference line: arrow-side symbols below it, other-side symbols above.

welding.label: ISO 2553 system A
welding.about: A solid reference line paired with a dashed identification line that carries the other-side symbol.

phylo.label: Slanted (default)
phylo.about: Diagonal branches meet at each ancestor. The default layout; phylograms preserve horizontal distances and cladograms align tips.

phylo.label: Rectangular
phylo.about: Elbow branches with vertical connectors. Supports distance trees, time trees and clustering dendrograms.
